info.title: ParlayAPI Real-time Odds Stream
info.description:
Machine-readable description of ParlayAPI's WebSocket and Server-Sent Events surface for real-time odds, props, and source-freshness updates. Generated 2026-05-14. Tier-gated to Business and above for connect; query params unchanged from REST.

Clients can generate type-safe SDKs from this spec via `asyncapi generate fromTemplate ./asyncapi.json @asyncapi/python-paho-template` or any of the 30+ AsyncAPI generators.

tags.name: WebSocket
tags.description: Bidirectional WebSocket stream with subscribe/unsubscribe commands. Authenticated via X-API-Key. Pinned to sports via path param.

tags.name: SSE Streaming
tags.description: Server-Sent Events one-way streams. Same odds data as the WebSocket plus specialty feeds (hot path, odds-drops, live in-play). Simpler reconnect semantics; works over plain HTTP/2.

tags.name: Live & In-Play
tags.description: Subset of streaming channels focused on currently-live games (in-play state changes, real-time score updates, period transitions).

production-ws.description: Production WebSocket endpoint. Connect with a Business+ API key. See `channels` for path templates.

production-sse.description: Production Server-Sent Events endpoint for /v1/sse/odds/{} and /v1/sse/hot/{}. Same data feed as WebSocket, streamed as text/event-stream. Use this when WebSocket upgrade is blocked (corporate proxies, browser EventSource API, HTTP-only environments).

production-v1.description: Production base for SSE endpoints that live outside the /v1/sse/ prefix: /v1/odds-drop/{} (price-drop alerts) and /v1/sports/{}/live/sse (in-play stream).

oddsStream.title: Programmatic odds stream
oddsStream.description:
API-key-authenticated WebSocket. Pushes one envelope per detected change in `odds_snapshots` or `prop_snapshots` for the subscribed sport. Push latency from DB insert to client frame is ~5 ms via Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY.

Three forms of API-key delivery accepted on the upgrade request: `?apiKey=<key>` query param, `X-API-Key: <key>` header, or `Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: apikey.<key>`.

sportKey.description: Sport key from /v1/sports (e.g. baseball_mlb, basketball_nba, soccer_epl).

sseOddsStream.title: Server-Sent Events odds stream
sseOddsStream.description:
API-key-authenticated SSE. Same data feed as the WebSocket channel above. One-way (server to client). Each message is a single `data:` line carrying the JSON envelope. Heartbeat every 5 seconds by default to prove the stream is live through corporate proxies.

Query params: apiKey, event_id, bookmakers, markets, kinds, heartbeat_s, limit, since, diff.

sseHotStream.title: Hot-tier SSE stream
sseHotStream.description:
Same data feed as /v1/sse/odds/{sportKey}, sourced from the hot-path collector for the small set of leagues currently in heavy live-betting use (NFL Sunday, NBA prime time, MLB late innings). Cadence target is tighter than the standard /sse/odds stream: 0.5-1.5 s vs 1-3 s. API-key-authenticated, Business+ tier required.

Query params identical to /sse/odds: apiKey, event_id, bookmakers, markets, kinds, heartbeat_s, limit, since, diff.

sportKey.description: Sport key from /v1/sports. Hot-tier coverage is league-gated; sports outside the hot rotation fall through to the standard /sse/odds cadence.

sseOddsDropStream.title: Price-drop alerts SSE stream
sseOddsDropStream.description:
Filtered SSE stream that emits only when a tracked price moves by at least `threshold` American-odds cents (default 5). Designed for steam-detection bots and CLV trackers that do not want a full odds feed. Each emitted event carries the before and after prices plus the wall-clock delta.

Query params: apiKey, threshold (int, default 5), bookmakers (CSV), markets (CSV), heartbeat_s (default 10), since (resume cursor in unix ms).

sseSportsLiveStream.title: In-play live SSE stream
sseSportsLiveStream.description:
SSE stream of in-play state changes for currently-live games of the subscribed sport: score, period, clock, last play. Emits one frame per state change observed in pbp_events; quiet windows fall through to heartbeats. API-key-authenticated.

Query params: apiKey, event_id (filter to one game), heartbeat_s.

Note: the `state` field of each frame is a JSON object carrying period / clock / status / raw_periods. Older spec versions encoded this field as a JSON string; current revision emits it as a nested object.

receiveOddsStream.title: Subscribe to programmatic odds stream
receiveOddsStream.description: Receive odds updates after sending the upgrade. Frames arrive in this order: one `connected`, one `initial_state`, then zero or more `odds_update` / `heartbeat` / `subscribed` / `unsubscribed` frames. A stream_status frame can disclose incomplete Pinnacle coverage separately from odds.

sendOddsCommands.title: Send client commands
sendOddsCommands.description: Send commands from client to server over the same WebSocket. Currently `subscribe` (filter to one event_id) and `unsubscribe` (drop the filter).

receiveSseStream.title: Subscribe to SSE odds stream
receiveSseStream.description: Receive odds updates as Server-Sent Events. Same data, different transport.

receiveSseHotStream.title: Subscribe to hot-tier SSE stream
receiveSseHotStream.description: Receive odds updates as SSE from the hot-path collector. Used by latency-sensitive consumers during live-betting windows on the small set of leagues in the hot rotation.

receiveSseOddsDropStream.title: Subscribe to price-drop alerts
receiveSseOddsDropStream.description: Receive only `odds_drop` frames where the change exceeds the configured threshold. Heavy filter on the server side; bandwidth is a tiny fraction of the full /sse/odds stream. Coverage diagnostics arrive separately as stream_status frames.

receiveSseSportsLiveStream.title: Subscribe to in-play live state stream
receiveSseSportsLiveStream.description: Receive per-game state changes (score, period, clock, last play) as SSE. Pairs with /v1/sports/{key}/live for current snapshot.

Connected.name: connected
Connected.title: Initial handshake frame
Connected.summary: Sent once immediately after upgrade. Confirms auth, tier, push mode, and any active query-param filters.

HotFeedStatus.name: hot_feed_status
HotFeedStatus.title: Source freshness snapshot (SSE only)
HotFeedStatus.summary: Sent once after `connected`, before `initial_state`. Carries the per-source freshness map at connect time so clients can decide whether to trust the immediate snapshot.

InitialState.name: initial_state
InitialState.title: Snapshot of current odds at connect time
InitialState.summary: Sent once after `connected`. Carries every active row for the subscribed sport, filtered by any active query params. Honors the `since` resume cursor when within the 60-minute lookback window; falls back to full snapshot with `truncated: true` otherwise.

OddsUpdate.name: odds_update
OddsUpdate.title: Change broadcast
OddsUpdate.summary: Sent every time a row in `odds_snapshots` or `prop_snapshots` for this sport changes. Payload shape varies by `diff_mode`: when off, every field of the affected row is included; when on, only the changed fields plus identifier fields are included.

Heartbeat.name: heartbeat
Heartbeat.title: Liveness ping
Heartbeat.summary: Sent on idle channel timeout (default 30 s for WS, configurable 1-30 s for SSE via `heartbeat_s`). Carries server timestamp; clients should treat absence of any frame for 2x heartbeat as a disconnect signal.

Subscribed.name: subscribed
Subscribed.title: Filter applied
Subscribed.summary: Server acknowledgement of a successful `subscribe` command. Subsequent `odds_update` frames are filtered to the requested event_id only.

Unsubscribed.name: unsubscribed
Unsubscribed.title: Filter cleared
Unsubscribed.summary: Server acknowledgement of a successful `unsubscribe` command. Subsequent `odds_update` frames are unfiltered again.

SubscribeCommand.name: subscribe
SubscribeCommand.title: Filter to one game
SubscribeCommand.summary: Client-to-server command. Restricts `odds_update` frames to a single event_id.

UnsubscribeCommand.name: unsubscribe
UnsubscribeCommand.title: Clear filter
UnsubscribeCommand.summary: Client-to-server command. Reverts to all-events broadcast.

OddsDrop.name: odds_drop
OddsDrop.title: Tracked price-drop event
OddsDrop.summary: Emitted only on the /v1/odds-drop/{sport_key} channel. Fires when a tracked price moves by at least the configured threshold (default 5 American-odds cents). Payload carries both the prior and the new price.

LiveState.name: live_state
LiveState.title: In-play state change
LiveState.summary: Emitted on the /v1/sports/{sport_key}/live/sse channel. Fires once per observed state change in pbp_events. Carries score, period, clock, and the last play.

StreamStatus.name: stream_status
StreamStatus.title: Stream coverage diagnostic
StreamStatus.summary: Reports unresolved Pinnacle fixture families once per subscription generation. It contains no odds. Valid families continue; a fresh current snapshot is required to clear the incomplete-coverage warning.

min_push_interval_s.description: Per-connection coalesce window. 0.0 = no coalesce (Scale tier). 0.5 = Enterprise. 1.0 = Business and other paying.

diff_mode.description: True when ?diff=true was set; subsequent odds_update frames carry only changed fields.

timestamp.description: Server unix timestamp at connect time.

since.description: Resume cursor in unix ms. Initial state will only include rows with timestamp_ms > since.

HotFeedStatusPayload.description: Best-effort source freshness telemetry sent after the SSE initial snapshot. An unavailable status does not close the odds stream and an empty sources array in that case is not a coverage statement.

status.description: Whether freshness telemetry was obtained within its independent time budget.

since.description: Effective resume cursor used by the server.

truncated.description: True when the requested limit, omitted records, or source-time resume fallback prevents a complete snapshot. Pinnacle uses a fresh current snapshot for source-time resume.

snapshot_complete.description: True only for a complete supported current snapshot within the requested scope.

snapshot_omitted_unresolved_families.description: Unresolved fixture family references encountered in the selected snapshot pages. Those families are not emitted.

coalesced.description: True when this envelope contains multiple ticks merged by the connection's min_push_interval throttle window.

OddsRow.description: Normalized row shape carrying either a game-level moneyline/spread/total OR a per-player prop. The `kind` discriminator switches between the two shapes. In diff mode, only changed fields plus the identifier fields are present.

last_update.description: Unix ms at which this row was written to the database.

market_key.description: Prop market key when kind=prop, e.g. player_points, player_rebounds.

_diff.description: Set to true when this row is a diff (only changed fields present).

removal_reason.description: fixture_unresolved is a local retirement of an earlier delivered selection. Clear its price; the original source clock and provider status are retained. Other local/provider removal reasons may also occur.

connections.description: Total active connections across all sports on this worker. Operational signal, not customer-facing.

timestamp.description: Server unix ms when this drop was observed.

side.description: Which side of the market moved.

delta_cents.description: Absolute change in American-odds cents. Always >= threshold.

elapsed_ms.description: Wall-clock ms between prior_price observation and new_price observation.

score_a.description: Home score (or first-listed-team for sports without a home/away convention).

state.description: Nested object carrying period, clock, status, and any raw_periods provenance. Older spec versions encoded this as a JSON string; current revision emits it as a real object.

last_play.description: Human-readable last play description, when available.

affected_families_in_page.description: Affected families in the reported committed page, not a total board count.

apiKeyQuery.name: apiKey
apiKeyQuery.description: ?apiKey=<key> on the WebSocket upgrade or SSE request URL.

apiKeyQuerySnakeCase.name: api_key
apiKeyQuerySnakeCase.description: ?api_key=<key>. The same credential as ?apiKey=; both spellings are accepted on every WebSocket and SSE route.

apiKeySubprotocol.description: Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: apikey.<key>. Useful for browsers and EventSource-style clients that cannot set arbitrary headers on the upgrade.

x-parlay-close-codes.description: Server-initiated close codes specific to ParlayAPI.

codes.4001: Tier gate (key below Business), or an expired dashboard session.
codes.4002: Concurrent connection cap reached for this tier. Close idle connections or upgrade.
codes.4003: Missing API key. Pass via ?apiKey=, ?api_key=, X-API-Key header, or Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: apikey.<key>. Identical on every WebSocket route, live and odds alike.

x-parlay-tier-gates.description: WebSocket and SSE require Business tier or above. Free, Starter, and Pro tiers connect but immediately close with 4001.
